# Rosé Pine Dawn

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-rose-pine-dawn)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-rose-pine-dawn)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-rose-pine-dawn)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-rose-pine-dawn)

Rosé Pine Dawn is a **light** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. Added in 6.31.0.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-rose-pine-dawn codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `rosePineDawn` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { rosePineDawn } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-rose-pine-dawn';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, rosePineDawn],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `rosePineDawn` | `Extension` |
| `rosePineDawnMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#faf4ed` |
| Active line | `#f4ede8` |
| Selection | `#dfdad9` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#266781` | - | 5.76:1 | 5.43:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#266781` | - | 5.76:1 | 5.43:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#615d7a` | - | 5.73:1 | 5.40:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#615d7a` | - | 5.73:1 | 5.40:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#575279` | - | 6.66:1 | 6.28:1 | 5.25:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#575279` | - | 6.66:1 | 6.28:1 | 5.25:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#974847` | - | 5.77:1 | 5.44:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#286873` | - | 5.80:1 | 5.46:1 | 4.57:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#575279` | background, active line, selection | 5.25:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#726e7f` | gutter | 4.52:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#575279` | background, active line | 6.28:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#6d5784` | background | 5.75:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #625e6e` | background, active line | 5.42:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#cecacd, 1px solid #974847` | background (fill or outline) | 5.77:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#dfdad9` | active line | 1.19:1 | Pass |
